result.instructions: Tools for noCRM.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my leads are still open in the Proposal step, and what are they worth?"; "Show the history of lead 8113 and list its comments."; "Create a lead for Acme Corp with John Doe's email and assign it to Stephanie.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes noCRM.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nocrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nocrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nocrm_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. nocrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nocrm_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List or search sales leads (noCRM.io's opportunities), newest first by default, with title, pipeline step, status, amount, probability, tags, owner, next reminder and the contact details in the description. Filter by status, step (names or ids, not mixed), owner, tags, email, starred or a date range. Unassigned leads are excluded unless include_unassigned is true. GET /leads.

status.description: Only leads in these statuses (todo = to do, standby = waiting for a reminder date).

steps.description: Only leads in these pipeline steps: exact step names OR step ids (not mixed). See nocrm_list_steps.

user_id.description: Only leads owned by this user (id or email).

tags.description: Only leads carrying ALL of these tags.

email.description: Only leads whose description or comments contain this email address.

include_unassigned.description: Also return leads that have no owner (default false).

date_range_type.description: Which date start_date/end_date apply to (default creation).

updated_after.description: Only leads updated on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd). Do not combine with date_range_type.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: nocrm_list_unassigned_leads
tools.title: List unassigned leads
tools.description: Leads that have no owner yet (for example web-form or API leads waiting to be handed to a salesperson). GET /leads/unassigned.

tools.name: nocrm_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: One lead by id: title, step, status, amount, probability, tags, owner, client folder, team, reminder, and the full description with the contact's details. GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: nocrm_list_lead_comments
tools.title: List lead comments
tools.description: The comments (notes, logged calls/meetings/emails) on a lead, newest first by default. GET /leads/{id}/comments.

tools.name: nocrm_list_lead_history
tools.title: List lead history
tools.description: The timeline of a lead: creation, assignments, step and status changes, amount changes, comments and emails sent, with who did it and when. Filter by date range, action type or user. GET /leads/{id}/action_histories.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: nocrm_get_lead_duplicates
tools.title: Find duplicate leads
tools.description: Leads that noCRM.io detects as possible duplicates of this lead (same email or key field). GET /leads/{id}/duplicates.

tools.name: nocrm_list_lead_attachments
tools.title: List lead attachments
tools.description: File attachments on a lead (names, ids, sizes, links). GET /leads/{id}/attachments.

tools.name: nocrm_list_follow_ups
tools.title: List post-sales follow-ups
tools.description: Post-sales processes (task checklists created from a template) of one lead OR of one user. Needs lead_id or user_id. Post-sales is a higher-edition feature (HTTP 403 otherwise). GET /follow_ups.

user_id.description: Follow-ups of this user (id or email).

tools.name: nocrm_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: The sales pipelines of the account (one unless the multiple-pipelines feature is on). GET /pipelines.

tools.name: nocrm_list_steps
tools.title: List pipeline steps
tools.description: The steps (stages) of the sales pipeline in order, with ids, positions and their pipeline. Use the ids or names when filtering leads or moving a lead. GET /steps.

tools.name: nocrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The users (salespeople) of the account with name, email, phone, role (admin or not) and whether they are active or deactivated. Deleted users are included, flagged is_disabled. GET /users.

email.description: Only the user with this email.

teams.description: Only users in these teams (ids or names).

tools.name: nocrm_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One user by id or email address. GET /users/{id}.

user.description: A user id or the user's email address (see nocrm_list_users).

tools.name: nocrm_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: Sales teams with their members and who manages each. The Teams feature must be on in the account (HTTP 403 otherwise). GET /teams.

tools.name: nocrm_list_client_folders
tools.title: List client folders
tools.description: Client folders (accounts that group several leads), ordered by name by default. GET /clients.

tools.name: nocrm_get_client_folder
tools.title: Get client folder
tools.description: One client folder by id, with its contact fields and owner. GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: nocrm_list_activities
tools.title: List activity types
tools.description: The activity types (call, email, meeting and their outcomes) that can be set on a comment or reminder. GET /activities.

tools.name: nocrm_list_predefined_tags
tools.title: List predefined tags
tools.description: The account's predefined tags (admin keys only; an HTTP 401 unauthorized_non_admin means the key lacks rights). GET /predefined_tags.

tools.name: nocrm_list_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: The custom fields defined for leads or client folders. GET /fields.

tools.name: nocrm_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a new lead. The description holds the contact's details, one 'Label: value' per line (for example 'Firstname: Ada', 'Email: ada@example.com', 'Phone: ...'); noCRM.io reads those lines. Without user_id the lead is created unassigned; a pipeline step can only be set when the lead is assigned. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two leads. POST /leads.

title.description: Lead title, usually the company name.

description.description: Contact details and notes, one 'Label: value' per line.

user_id.description: Owner (id or email). Omit for an unassigned lead.

step.description: Pipeline step id or exact name. Needs user_id.

tools.name: nocrm_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: WRITE: change a lead: title, status (won, lost, cancelled, todo or standby), pipeline step, amount, probability, star, estimated closing date, tags (replaces the lead's tag list), or append text to the description (existing description text is never replaced). Moving to standby needs remind_date. Only the fields you pass change. PUT /leads/{id}.

step.description: Move to this step (id or exact name; prefer the id when pipelines share names).

amount.description: Deal amount in the account currency.

estimated_closing_date.description: yyyy-mm-dd, in the account's time zone.

remind_time.description: Reminder time HH:MM, 24 h, in 15-minute steps.

tags.description: The lead's tags after the update (replaces the current list; new tags are created).

append_description.description: Text added at the end of the description.

tools.name: nocrm_assign_lead
tools.title: Assign lead
tools.description: WRITE: assign a lead to a user (id or email), replacing its current owner. The owner may get a notification from noCRM.io. POST /leads/{id}/assign.

tools.name: nocrm_add_lead_comment
tools.title: Add lead comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment (an internal note) to a lead, optionally typed as an activity such as a call or meeting. It is visible to the lead's team in noCRM.io and sends nothing to the customer. Not idempotent. POST /leads/{id}/comments.

activity_id.description: Activity type id (see nocrm_list_activities), for example the id of 'Call'.

tools.name: nocrm_create_client_folder
tools.title: Create client folder
tools.description: WRITE: create a client folder (an account that groups leads). Not idempotent. POST /clients.

tools.name: nocrm_add_lead_to_client_folder
tools.title: Add lead to client folder
tools.description: WRITE: file a lead under a client folder. POST /leads/{id}/add_to_client.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with noCRM.io
prompts.description: What you can do with noCRM.io here, with example requests to try.
